title: Cartwise+ Membership Opening Retention Rates by Term Age and Payment Record
content:
The opening retention rate applied to the refund of the charge that opened a Cartwise+ Membership annual term, when the term is ended early, depends on the term's age and on the member's payment record.

| Whole months of the term completed | Retry captures on the membership in the last twelve months | Opening retention rate |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 3 | none | 100% (1.0) |
| fewer than 3 | at least one | 95% (0.95) |
| 3 or more | any | no rate is set under this schedule |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Term age.** The whole months of the term completed are counted from the term's first day up to today; a month is complete on the same day of the month as the term's first day.
2. **Retry capture.** A retry capture is a fee charge of the renewal-retry type on the membership — a declined period fee captured on a later attempt, whether by an automatic retry or by the member settling in person.
3. **Twelve months.** The last twelve months are counted as whole months ending today; a capture dated on the same day of the month twelve months back is not counted.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Term began | Today | Whole months completed | Retry capture in last twelve months | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January | 9 April | 2 | none | 100% |
| 10 January | 10 April | 3 | none | not set under this schedule |
| 10 January | 20 February | 1 | one, dated 15 September of the previous year | 95% |
| 10 January | 20 February | 1 | one, dated 20 February of the previous year | 100% (exactly twelve months back, not counted) |
